finding: Current main FrankExecutionGate returns physical BUSY without opening UnifiedDB; therefore ExecutionAcquireReceipt has lease_epoch=null, holder_kind=null and surface_location=null. Current token ingress further deliberately emits only coarse FRANK_BUSY.
security_reason: Do not leak active holder/session/location merely because a bearer client collides with the physical execution lock.
integration_consequence: PRESENCE_INTERRUPT_V1 cannot be safely wired by asking the current coarse BUSY response to echo observed_lease_epoch, because physical BUSY has no epoch at that boundary.

required_next_design.minimum_stale_safety: bind interrupt intent to exact canonical lease_epoch or an opaque server-side challenge bound to that epoch
required_next_design.location_policy: surface_location must remain redacted by default and may be exposed only under an explicit authenticated scope/privacy policy
required_next_design.authority: status/challenge must not acquire or transfer presence and must not bypass FrankExecutionGate for cognition/effects
required_next_design.race_test: holder A observed -> holder transition -> stale challenge/request must not target holder B
